impact_assessment.benefits: Analyze answers about the file the caller named, an empty requirements document cannot pass silently, and long tracks analyze faster
impact_assessment.risks: contract: analyze behavior only; dependency: standard library operator module; concurrency: none; state: CHANGELOG and ledger
impact_assessment.mitigation: Fix each case with a regression test, compare analyze timing before and after, then run the suite and gates

[1/4] Plan the Keystone integration groundwork: add a sample_width_bits requirement so 'muse analyze' can express Keystone's mono-16-bit read_wav contract, ship a presets/keystone-audio.json, document the bridge, and prove a Muse-rendered track loads through keystone.audio.read_wav

impact_assessment.why: Hard integration is the stated direction; Keystone's audio core only reads mono 16-bit WAV, and Muse's analyzer can check channels but not bit depth, so the contract cannot be expressed or gated today
impact_assessment.benefits: The Keystone audio contract becomes a one-line requirements gate, and end-to-end compatibility is measured rather than assumed
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one new requirement key and a data preset; dependency: none (verification imports keystone locally only, never vendors it); concurrency: none; state: CHANGELOG, version, ADR, ledger
impact_assessment.mitigation: Mirror the existing channels parser, cover int/list/invalid forms, verify with a real keystone.audio.read_wav call, then run the suite and gates
